HP:0000822.label: Hypertension
HP:0000822.description: The presence of chronic increased pressure in the systemic arterial system.

HP:0001297.label: Stroke
HP:0001297.description: Sudden impairment of blood flow to a part of the brain due to occlusion or rupture of an artery to the brain.

HP:0001342.label: Cerebral hemorrhage
HP:0001342.description: Hemorrhage into the parenchyma of the brain.

HP:0001513.label: Obesity
HP:0001513.description: Accumulation of substantial excess body fat.

HP:0001653.label: Mitral regurgitation
HP:0001653.description: An abnormality of the mitral valve characterized by insufficiency or incompetence of the mitral valve resulting in retrograde leaking of blood through the mitral valve upon ventricular contraction.

HP:0001681.label: Angina pectoris
HP:0001681.description: Paroxysmal chest pain that occurs with exertion or stress and is related to myocardial ischemia.

HP:0001712.label: Left ventricular hypertrophy
HP:0001712.description: Enlargement or increased size of the heart left ventricle.

HP:0001714.label: Ventricular hypertrophy
HP:0001714.description: Enlargement of the cardiac ventricular muscle tissue with increase in the width of the wall of the ventricle and loss of elasticity. Ventricular hypertrophy is clinically differentiated into left and right ventricular hypertrophy.

HP:0001718.label: Mitral stenosis
HP:0001718.description: An abnormal narrowing of the orifice of the mitral valve.

HP:0002140.label: Ischemic stroke
HP:0002140.description: Acute ischemic stroke (AIS) is defined by the sudden loss of blood flow to an area of the brain with the resulting loss of neurologic function. It is caused by thrombosis or embolism that occludes a cerebral vessel supplying a specific area of the brain. During a vessel occlusion, there is a core area where damage to the brain is irreversible and an area of penumbra where the brain has lost function owing to decreased blood flow but is not irreversibly injured.

HP:0002621.label: Atherosclerosis
HP:0002621.description: A condition characterized by patchy atheromas or atherosclerotic plaques which develop in the walls of medium-sized and large arteries and can lead to arterial stenosis with reduced or blocked blood flow.

HP:0002625.label: Deep venous thrombosis
HP:0002625.description: Formation of a blot clot in a deep vein. The clot often blocks blood flow, causing swelling and pain. The deep veins of the leg are most often affected.
synonyms: Blood clot in a deep vein

HP:0003193.label: Allergic rhinitis
HP:0003193.description: It is characterized by one or more symptoms including sneezing, itching, nasal congestion, and rhinorrhea.

HP:0004417.label: Intermittent claudication
HP:0004417.description: Intermittent claudication is a symptom of peripheral arterial occlusive disease. After having walked over a distance which is individually characteristic, the patients experience pain or cramps in the calves, feet or thighs which typically subsides on standing still.

HP:0010535.label: Sleep apnea
HP:0010535.description: An intermittent cessation of airflow at the mouth and nose during sleep is known as sleep apnea. Apneas that last at least 10 seconds are considered significant, but individuals with sleep apnea may experience apneas lasting from 20 seconds up to 2 or 3 minutes. Patients may have up to 15 events per hour of sleep.

HP:0012393.label: Allergy
HP:0012393.description: An allergy is an immune response or reaction to substances that are usually not harmful.

HP:0030828.label: Wheezing
HP:0030828.description: A high-pitched whistling sound associated with labored breathing.

MONDO:0000270.label: lower respiratory tract disorder
MONDO:0000270.description: A disease involving the lower respiratory tract.
synonyms: disease or disorder of lower respiratory tract
lower respiratory tract disease or disorder

MONDO:0000745.label: cardiac arrest
MONDO:0000745.description: Cessation of breathing and/or cardiac function.

MONDO:0000831.label: thrombotic disease
MONDO:0000831.description: The formation of a blood clot in the lumen of a vessel or heart chamber; causes include coagulation disorders and vascular endothelial injury.

MONDO:0001302.label: hypertensive heart disease
MONDO:0001302.description: Abnormal enlargement of the heart resulting from long-standing hypertension.

MONDO:0002771.label: pulmonary fibrosis
MONDO:0002771.description: Chronic progressive interstitial lung disorder characterized by the replacement of the lung tissue by connective tissue, leading to progressive dyspnea, respiratory failure, or right heart failure. Causes include chronic inflammatory processes, exposure to environmental irritants, radiation therapy, autoimmune disorders, certain drugs, or it may be idiopathic (no identifiable cause).

child_labels.MONDO:0000148: pulmonary fibrosis and/or bone marrow failure, telomere-related

MONDO:0002869.label: heart valve disorder
MONDO:0002869.description: A disease involving the cardial valve.
synonyms: disease or disorder of cardial valve

MONDO:0003767.label: mitral valve disorder
MONDO:0003767.description: A disease involving the mitral valve.
synonyms: disease or disorder of mitral valve

child_labels.MONDO:0015109: congenital anomaly of the mitral subvalvular apparatus

MONDO:0003803.label: aortic valve disorder
MONDO:0003803.description: A disease involving the aortic valve.
synonyms: disease or disorder of aortic valve

MONDO:0004784.label: allergic asthma
MONDO:0004784.description: A asthma with a basis in a pathological type I hypersensitivity reaction.

MONDO:0004848.label: ulcerative stomatitis
MONDO:0004848.description: Inflammation of the mouth mucosa associated with the presence of ulcers.

MONDO:0004849.label: pulmonary emphysema
MONDO:0004849.description: A subcategory of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). It occurs in people who smoke and suffer from chronic bronchitis. It is characterized by inflation of the alveoli, alveolar wall damage, and reduction in the number of alveoli, resulting in difficulty breathing.

MONDO:0004979.label: asthma
MONDO:0004979.description: A bronchial disease that is characterized by chronic inflammation and narrowing of the airways, which is caused by a combination of environmental and genetic factors resulting in recurring periods of wheezing (a whistling sound while breathing), chest tightness, shortness of breath, mucus production and coughing. The symptoms appear due to a variety of triggers such as allergens, irritants, respiratory infections, weather changes, exercise, stress, reflux disease, medications, foods and emotional anxiety.

MONDO:0004981.label: atrial fibrillation
MONDO:0004981.description: A disorder characterized by an electrocardiographic finding of a supraventricular arrhythmia characterized by the replacement of consistent P waves by rapid oscillations or fibrillatory waves that vary in size, shape and timing and are accompanied by an irregular ventricular response. (CDISC)

MONDO:0004995.label: cardiovascular disorder
MONDO:0004995.description: A disease involving the cardiovascular system.

child_labels.MONDO:0012726: autosomal dominant familial hematuria-retinal arteriolar tortuosity-contractures syndrome

MONDO:0005002.label: chronic obstructive pulmonary disease
MONDO:0005002.description: A chronic and progressive lung disorder characterized by the loss of elasticity of the bronchial tree and the air sacs, destruction of the air sacs wall, thickening of the bronchial wall, and mucous accumulation in the bronchial tree. The pathologic changes result in the disruption of the air flow in the bronchial airways. Signs and symptoms include shortness of breath, wheezing, productive cough, and chest tightness. The two main types of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease are chronic obstructive bronchitis and emphysema.

MONDO:0005009.label: congestive heart failure
MONDO:0005009.description: Failure of the heart to pump a sufficient amount of blood to meet the needs of the body tissues, resulting in tissue congestion and edema. Signs and symptoms include shortness of breath, pitting edema, enlarged tender liver, engorged neck veins, and pulmonary rales.

MONDO:0005010.label: coronary artery disorder
MONDO:0005010.description: Narrowing of the coronary arteries due to fatty deposits inside the arterial walls. The diagnostic criteria may include documented history of any of the following: documented coronary artery stenosis greater than or equal to 50% (by cardiac catheterization or other modality of direct imaging of the coronary arteries); previous coronary artery bypass surgery (CABG); previous percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI); previous myocardial infarction. (ACC)

child_labels.MONDO:0980999: fibromuscular dysplasia of the coronary arteries

MONDO:0005015.label: diabetes mellitus
MONDO:0005015.description: A metabolic disorder characterized by abnormally high blood sugar levels due to diminished production of insulin or insulin resistance/desensitization.

MONDO:0005068.label: myocardial infarction
MONDO:0005068.description: Gross necrosis of the myocardium, as a result of interruption of the blood supply to the area, as in coronary thrombosis.

MONDO:0005099.label: subarachnoid hemorrhage
MONDO:0005099.description: A serious neurological disorder characterized by intracranial hemorrhage into the subarachnoid space.

MONDO:0005139.label: morbid obesity
MONDO:0005139.description: An excess of body weight, normally defined as an individual with a body mass index greater than 35 or a body weight greater than one hundred percent of ideal body weight.

MONDO:0005149.label: pulmonary hypertension
MONDO:0005149.description: Increased pressure within the pulmonary circulation due to lung or heart disorder.

child_labels.MONDO:0017157: pulmonary hypertension owing to lung disease and/or hypoxia

MONDO:0005252.label: heart failure
MONDO:0005252.description: Inability of the heart to pump blood at an adequate rate to meet tissue metabolic requirements. Clinical symptoms of heart failure include: unusual dyspnea on light exertion, recurrent dyspnea occurring in the supine position, fluid retention or rales, jugular venous distension, pulmonary edema on physical exam, or pulmonary edema on chest x-ray presumed to be cardiac dysfunction.

MONDO:0005264.label: transient ischemic attack
MONDO:0005264.description: A brief attack (from a few minutes to an hour) of cerebral dysfunction of vascular origin, with no persistent neurological deficit.

MONDO:0005267.label: heart disorder
MONDO:0005267.description: A disease involving the heart and/or pericardium.

child_labels.MONDO:0010825: atrioventricular defect-blepharophimosis-radial and anal defect syndrome
child_labels.MONDO:0044649: omphalocele-diaphragmatic hernia-cardiovascular anomalies-radial ray defect syndrome

MONDO:0005279.label: pulmonary embolism
MONDO:0005279.description: The obstruction of the pulmonary artery or one of its branches by an embolus, sometimes associated with infarction of the lung.

MONDO:0005294.label: peripheral vascular disease
MONDO:0005294.description: Any disorder affecting blood flow through the veins or arteries outside of the heart.

MONDO:0005296.label: sleep apnea syndrome
MONDO:0005296.description: A disorder characterized by multiple cessations of respirations during sleep that induce partial arousals and interfere with the maintenance of sleep.

MONDO:0005311.label: atherosclerosis
MONDO:0005311.description: A disease characterized by the build-up of fatty material and calcium deposition in the arterial wall resulting in partial or complete occlusion of the arterial lumen.

MONDO:0005386.label: peripheral arterial disease
MONDO:0005386.description: A disorder of the arteries supplying the upper and lower extremity and the visceral organs. This includes the mesenteric arteries, the renal arteries and the aorta and excludes cerebrovascular arterial disease. Patients experience cramping and pain usually in the calves and thighs while walking. The symptoms subside with rest.

MONDO:0005394.label: brain infarction
MONDO:0005394.description: Tissue necrosis in any area of the brain, including the cerebral hemispheres, the cerebellum, and the brain stem. Brain infarction is the result of a cascade of events initiated by inadequate blood flow through the brain that is followed by hypoxia and hypoglycemia in brain tissue. Damage may be temporary, permanent, selective or pan-necrosis.

MONDO:0005399.label: venous thromboembolism
MONDO:0005399.description: Occlusion of the lumen of a vein by a thrombus that has migrated from a distal site via the blood stream.

MONDO:0005453.label: congenital heart disease
MONDO:0005453.description: A heart disease that is present at birth. Representative examples include atrial septal defect, ventricular septal defect, tetralogy of Fallot, and patent foramen ovale.

child_labels.MONDO:0019443: dextro-looped transposition of the great arteries
child_labels.MONDO:0700352: ACTC1-related distal arthrogryposis with congenital heart disease
child_labels.MONDO:0100009: structural congenital heart disease, multiple types - GATA4
child_labels.MONDO:0100540: GATA6-related congenital heart disease with or without pancreatic agenesis or neonatal diabetes
child_labels.MONDO:1010098: TFAP2B-related congenital heart disease spectrum disorder

MONDO:0005492.label: urticaria
MONDO:0005492.description: A vascular reaction of the skin characterized by erythema and wheal formation due to localized increase of vascular permeability. The causative mechanism may be allergy, infection, or stress.

child_labels.MONDO:0015340: drug rash with eosinophilia and systemic symptoms
child_labels.MONDO:0008353: pruritic urticarial papules and plaques of pregnancy

MONDO:0005607.label: chronic bronchitis
MONDO:0005607.description: A type of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease characterized by chronic inflammation in the bronchial tree that results in edema, mucus production, obstruction, and reduced airflow to and from the lung alveoli. The most common cause is tobacco smoking. Signs and symptoms include coughing with excessive mucus production, and shortness of breath.

MONDO:0005648.label: aortic valve insufficiency
MONDO:0005648.description: Dysfunction of the aortic valve characterized by incomplete valve closure.

MONDO:0006803.label: inferior myocardial infarction
MONDO:0006803.description: Myocardial infarction in which the inferior wall of the heart is involved. It is often caused by occlusion of the right coronary artery.

MONDO:0006809.label: intracranial embolism
MONDO:0006809.description: Blocking of a blood vessel in the skull by an embolus which can be a blood clot (thrombus) or other undissolved material in the blood stream. Most emboli are of cardiac origin and are associated with heart diseases. Other non-cardiac sources of emboli are usually associated with vascular diseases.

MONDO:0006955.label: rheumatic heart disease
MONDO:0006955.description: An autoinflammatory condition following an infection with Group A Beta Hemolytic Streptococcus (GABHS), in which the heart is attacked by antibodies formed in reaction to a recent GABHS infection. Chief anatomic changes of the valve include leaflet thickening, commissural fusion, and shortening and thickening of the tendinous cords, all of which can result in valvular dysfunction.

MONDO:0011057.label: cerebrovascular disorder
MONDO:0011057.description: A disorder resulting from inadequate blood flow in the vessels that supply the brain. Representative examples include cerebrovascular ischemia, cerebral embolism, and cerebral infarction.

child_labels.MONDO:0018832: HTRA1-related autosomal dominant cerebral small vessel disease
child_labels.MONDO:0032814: microangiopathy and leukoencephalopathy, pontine, autosomal dominant

MONDO:0011122.label: obesity disorder
MONDO:0011122.description: A disorder involving an excessive amount of body fat.

MONDO:0024355.label: respiratory tract infectious disorder
MONDO:0024355.description: Invasion of the host RESPIRATORY SYSTEM by microorganisms, usually leading to pathological processes or diseases.

MONDO:0024644.label: myocardial ischemia
MONDO:0024644.description: A disorder of cardiac function caused by insufficient blood flow to the muscle tissue of the heart. The decreased blood flow may be due to narrowing of the coronary arteries (coronary artery disease), to obstruction by a thrombus (coronary thrombosis), or less commonly, to diffuse narrowing of arterioles and other small vessels within the heart. Severe interruption of the blood supply to the myocardial tissue may result in necrosis of cardiac muscle (myocardial infarction).

MONDO:0042981.label: aortic valve stenosis
MONDO:0042981.description: Aortic valve stenosis (AVS) is a condition characterized by narrowing of the heart's aortic valve opening. This narrowing prevents the valve from opening fully, which obstructs blood flow from the heart into the aorta, and onward to the rest of the body. AVS can range from mild to severe. Signs and symptoms typically develop when the narrowing of the opening is severe and may include chest pain (angina) or tightness; shortness of breath or fatigue (especially during exertion); feeling faint or fainting; heart palpitations; and heart murmur. Individuals with less severe congenital AVS (present at birth) may not develop symptoms until adulthood. Individuals with severe cases may faint without warning. AVS can have several causes including abnormal development before birth (such as having 1 or 2 valve leaflets instead of 3); calcium build-up on the valve in adulthood; and rheumatic fever.

MONDO:0850282.label: chronic asthma
MONDO:0850282.description: An asthma that is characterized by the development of persistent airway inflammation and recurrent attacks of breathlessness and wheezing, which vary in severity and frequency.
